That’s where @gaib_ai steps in. With $AID tokens, they’ve cracked a way for regular people like us to co-own pieces of this infrastructure and earn when AI companies tap into it.

Here’s the breakdown:
• AI lives and breathes on insanely powerful (and expensive) computers
• Supply is limited and demand is endless, every AI startup is fighting to rent them
• GAIB fractionalizes access so anyone can hold pieces of this compute power
• Every time those machines get used, the rewards loop back to $AID stakers

So instead of just betting on whether some AI stock pumps, you’re plugged directly into the machines that all AI companies need to run.

Think about it, every ChatGPT conversation, every Claude query, every MidJourney artwork is powered by GPUs. When they run, your piece of the network works too, and you get paid.

This flips the game entirely. A student in Lagos or Manila can now earn off the same AI infrastructure as someone in Silicon Valley. Just by holding and staking $AID.

Stake → Earn from real compute usage → Repeat.

It’s not speculation, it’s ownership of the AI economy’s foundation. Like owning the electricity grid instead of picking which lightbulb stock might win.

The AI boom isn’t slowing down, and GAIB is making sure the value flows to the people, not just the giants.
